  7. Make a plan for the morning: Having a reason to get out of bed can motivate you.
  8. Gradually adjust your wake-up time: Adjust by 15-30 minutes every few days.
  9. Use accountability: Share your goals with someone to hold you accountable.
  10. Be patient and flexible: It may take time for your body to adjust.
